quote: Magnetic lines of force near Earth's surface become twisted and tangled, and magnetic poles pop up in unaccustomed places... hunting for magnetic poles while auroras danced overhead.
words_flag: City names are the locked spoken words. They are examples in the line, not a surveyed aurora catalogue. Cairo is the only pin on this plate.

checks.samples_inspected: 1.20 s shows GREEN AND CRIMSON on the northern limb. 3.10 s shows FUNNEL DOWN as the bands move south. 4.60 s shows THE MIDDLE across the centre of the disc. 6.40 s shows LONDON in the margin with a ribbon to the northwest limb. 7.30 s shows CAIRO with the pin on the Nile delta. 8.30 s shows MUMBAI in the right margin. 9.50 s shows SYDNEY in the lower-right margin. Curtains are still shimmering. London, Mumbai and Sydney are off this eastern-hemisphere plate.
